questionText: The major implication of a high dependency ratio on an economy is
explanation: When few workers must support many dependants, income is consumed rather than saved, savings and investment stay low and incomes remain low in turn. That self-reinforcing circle is the vicious cycle of poverty.

questionText: One of the major problems of the agricultural sector in Nigeria is
explanation: Nigerian farming still depends largely on the hoe and cutlass, which limits the area a farmer can cultivate and keeps yields low. Mechanisation is the single greatest constraint on output.

questionText: Cooperative societies are characterized by
explanation: Membership of a cooperative is voluntary and open: anyone who can use its services may join and any member may withdraw. Members also share a common, not a divergent, interest.

questionText: The marginal propensity to save measures the

options.A: ratio of change in saving to a change in the level of income
options.B: change in supply as a result of a change in consumption
options.C: ratio of change in consumption to a change in the level of income

explanation: MPS is ΔS ÷ ΔY, the fraction of any additional income that is saved rather than spent. The ratio of the change in consumption to the change in income is the marginal propensity to consume.

questionText: Structural unemployment is mainly caused by

options.A: a change in the consumption pattern
options.B: a change in the business cycle

explanation: When tastes or techniques shift, the demand for a particular product collapses and the workers whose skills were tied to it are left stranded. Business cycle swings produce cyclical, not structural, unemployment.

questionText: One of the major problems of census in Nigeria is
explanation: Because revenue allocation and political representation depend on population, figures have repeatedly been inflated for advantage. This deliberate distortion is what has made Nigerian census results so contentious.

questionText: A decrease in government expenditure in an economy will cause the general price level to
explanation: Government spending is a component of aggregate demand, so cutting it withdraws purchasing power from the economy. With less money chasing the same goods, prices fall.

questionText:
Study the table below.

| Unit of labour | TP | AP | MP |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 6 | 6 | – |
| 2 | 14 | 7 | 8 |
| 3 | K | 9 | 13 |
| 4 | 40 | 10 | F |

From the table above, find the values of K and F respectively.
explanation: Total product is average product times the number of units, so K = 9 × 3 = 27. Marginal product is the addition to total product, so F = 40 − 27 = 13.

questionText: In the theory of consumer behaviour, the sum of all marginal utilities is
explanation: Each unit consumed adds its marginal utility to the stock of satisfaction already obtained, so adding all the marginal utilities together gives total utility.

questionText: In a pure capitalist economy, the means and forces of production are owned and controlled by the
explanation: Private ownership of the means of production is the defining feature of capitalism. Joint ownership by both sectors describes a mixed economy and state ownership a socialist one.

questionText: A factor earning which is paid out as unemployment benefit is referred to as
explanation: A transfer payment is money the government hands over without receiving any good or service in return, as with unemployment benefit or a pension. Because nothing is produced for it, it is excluded from national income to avoid double counting.

questionText: The demand for money is referred to as the

options.A: amount of money in fixed deposit
options.B: desire to hold money in tangible assets
options.D: desire to hold money in liquid form rather than investing it

explanation: Keynes called the demand for money liquidity preference: the wish to keep wealth in cash, which earns nothing, rather than in interest-bearing assets. It arises from the transactions, precautionary and speculative motives.

questionText: In the theory of production, a producer is at equilibrium at a point where

options.A: isocost is above the isoquant curve
options.B: isoquant is below the isocost curve
options.C: isocost is tangent to the marginal revenue
options.D: isoquant is tangent to the isocost curve

explanation: At the point of tangency the producer obtains the greatest output for a given outlay, because the rate at which he can substitute one factor for another equals the rate at which the market prices them.

questionText: Balance of trade shows the relationship between the

options.B: total value of visible imports and exports
options.C: deficit and surplus balance of payments
options.D: total value of invisible imports and exports

explanation: The balance of trade records only the tangible goods crossing a country's borders. Services and other invisibles belong to the wider current account, not to the balance of trade.

questionText: If the cash reserve ratio is 30%, a new deposit of ₦20 million will increase supply by
explanation: The credit multiplier is 1 ÷ cash reserve ratio = 1 ÷ 0.30 = 3.33. Applying it to the deposit gives ₦20 million × 3.33 = ₦66.7 million.

questionText: A fall in the price of ostentatious goods will
explanation: Ostentatious or Veblen goods are bought precisely because they are expensive and confer prestige. When the price falls they lose that distinction, so buyers take fewer of them — an exception to the law of demand.

questionText: Payment of interest on loans and the repayment of the capital sum at a future date is
explanation: Debt servicing is the regular discharge of a debt obligation — the interest as it falls due together with the principal at maturity. Debt relief, by contrast, is the cancellation or reduction of what is owed.

questionText: The most difficult measure of central tendency to determine in a grouped data is the
explanation: Once data are grouped the individual values are lost, so the mode can only be estimated by interpolation within the modal class rather than read off directly. Range and variance are measures of dispersion, not of central tendency.

questionText: Localization of industry is mainly determined by
explanation: Firms of an industry gather where the material they work on is found, particularly when it is bulky or loses weight in processing. That is why brewing, quarrying and cement works cluster near their sources.

questionText: Geographical distribution of a population is affected by
explanation: People settle where they can make a living, and fertile land able to support farming draws them most strongly. Birth rates change the size of a population rather than where it is spread.

questionText: A tax burden on a commodity will be shared equally if the demand is
explanation: Incidence is divided according to the relative elasticities of demand and supply. Only when demand is unitary elastic, matching supply in responsiveness, do buyer and seller carry the tax in equal shares.

questionText: Higher income taxes can be used to control
explanation: Raising income tax withdraws purchasing power from households, which reduces the excess demand that is pulling prices up. It cannot touch cost-push inflation, whose source is rising costs of production.

questionText: From the graph above, a shift of the supply curve from S₀S₀ to S₁S₁ will lead to

options.A: a decrease in price and quantity
options.B: no change in price and quantity
options.C: an increase in price and quantity
options.D: a decrease in price and an increase in quantity

explanation: The supply curve moves to the right along an unchanged demand curve, so the intersection slides down that curve. Price falls from P₀ to P₁ while quantity rises from Q₀ to Q₁.

questionText: An indifference map is made up of a set of
explanation: An indifference map is the whole family of a consumer's indifference curves drawn on one diagram, each curve further from the origin representing a higher level of satisfaction.

questionText: Recapitalization policy will enable commercial banks to

options.D: have a very strong capital base

explanation: Recapitalisation raises the minimum shareholders' funds a bank must hold, so its direct effect is a stronger capital base able to absorb losses and support larger lending.

questionText: The number of persons required to form a private company ranges from
explanation: A private limited liability company is formed by a minimum of two members and may not exceed fifty, excluding employees. A public company has a minimum of seven with no upper limit.

questionText: The major function of the International Monetary Fund is the

options.A: provision of short-run loans to medium scale industries
options.B: provision of long-term loans for infrastructure
options.C: development of agriculture in member countries

explanation: The IMF was established to promote orderly exchange arrangements and to lend to members in balance of payments difficulty. Long-term project finance is the business of the World Bank.

questionText: One of the major activities in the upstream sector of the Nigerian petroleum industry includes
explanation: The upstream sector covers the search for and extraction of crude oil, that is exploration, drilling and production. Refining, transportation and marketing of finished products all belong to the downstream sector.

questionText: The law of supply states that the

options.A: higher the price the higher the quantity supplied
options.B: quantity supplied is always equal to the quantity demanded
options.C: lower the price the higher the quantity supplied
options.D: higher the price the lower the quantity supplied

explanation: A higher price makes production more profitable, so sellers offer more, other things being equal. Price and quantity supplied therefore move in the same direction, giving the supply curve its upward slope.

questionText: One of the features of a perfectly competitive firm is
explanation: Perfect competition assumes there is no transport cost, so a single price rules throughout the market. Restricted entry, price discrimination and differentiated products all belong to imperfect markets.

questionText: The basis for international trade is the

options.C: prevailing interest rate on multilateral loans

explanation: Countries are unequally supplied with land, climate and minerals, so each can produce some things more cheaply than others. That unequal endowment is what makes specialisation and exchange worthwhile.

questionText: Training farmers on improved farming techniques is the major activity of
explanation: Agricultural extension officers take the findings of research stations out to the farms, demonstrating improved seed, fertiliser use and husbandry to the farmers themselves.

questionText: In a free market economy, prices are determined by

options.D: the forces of demand and supply

explanation: In a free market no authority fixes prices; they settle at the level where the quantity buyers want equals the quantity sellers offer.

questionText: The basic economic problem of what to produce in an economy is determined by
explanation: The problem arises because resources are scarce relative to wants, so what a society can produce is bounded by the resources at its disposal. Choice is forced on it by that scarcity.

questionText: In Nigeria, a fall in the supply of petrol would generally affect the

options.C: general price level in the country

explanation: Petrol drives road transport, on which the movement of virtually every good depends. A shortage raises transport costs and those costs are passed on across the economy, lifting the general price level.

questionText: The short-run equilibrium point of a perfectly competitive firm is attained at a point where

options.A: total revenue is equal to total cost
options.B: the demand curve is tangential to the marginal cost
options.C: the marginal cost curve is equal to the marginal revenue curve
options.D: the marginal cost is equal to the price of the firm

explanation: Profit is greatest where the addition to cost from the last unit exactly equals the addition to revenue, that is where MC = MR. This condition holds in every market structure, not only in perfect competition.

questionText: Government can protect consumers from exploitative prices by introducing
explanation: A maximum price is a legal ceiling below the equilibrium, fixed so that essential goods remain within reach of consumers. A minimum price or price floor is set above equilibrium to protect producers instead.

questionText: If a fall in the price of commodity K brought about an increase in the demand for commodity Y, the two commodities are
explanation: Goods used together move in this way: cheaper cars raise the demand for petrol. If they were substitutes, a fall in the price of K would have reduced the demand for Y.

questionText: In the theory of production, the price of a factor input is determined by
explanation: Factor demand is derived from the demand for what the factor helps produce, and how responsive that demand is to price governs what the factor can command. The less elastic the demand for a factor, the higher the reward it can obtain.

questionText: From the graph above, find the modal score.
explanation: The mode is the score achieved by the greatest number of students, which is the tallest bar on the chart. That bar stands at 20 students against a mark of 60.

questionText: When the selling price of a monopolist is below his short-run marginal cost, he is said to be making
explanation: If each additional unit costs more to produce than it fetches in the market, the firm is adding to its deficit with every sale. Price below marginal cost therefore means losses.

questionText: The overall economic performance of a country can be assessed through
explanation: National income measures the total value of goods and services produced in a year, so comparing successive estimates shows whether the economy as a whole is growing. Employment and the balance of payments cover only parts of the picture.

questionText: The supply of agricultural products is mainly determined by
explanation: How much a farmer can bring to market depends on the methods and equipment available to him — improved seed, fertiliser and machinery all raise output. The other options are determinants of demand, not supply.

questionText: Determine the median of 6, 10, 5, 12, 20, 18, 20 and 4.
explanation: Arranged in order the values are 4, 5, 6, 10, 12, 18, 20, 20. With eight items the median is the average of the fourth and fifth: (10 + 12) ÷ 2 = 11.

questionText:
Study the table below.

| X | 11–20 | 21–30 | 31–40 | 41–50 | 51–60 | 61–70 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| F | 4 | 6 | 10 | 50 | 3 | 5 |

From the table above, find the range of the distribution.
explanation: The range is the highest value less the lowest. Here that is 70 − 11 = 59.

questionText: The failure of the Nigerian industrial sector is mainly associated with
explanation: Erratic power supply, poor roads and weak transport networks raise production costs and make Nigerian manufactures uncompetitive. Raw materials and a large domestic market are not what the sector lacks.

questionText: If Qd = 40 − 4P and P = ₦4, what is the quantity demanded?
explanation: Substitute P = 4 into the equation: Qd = 40 − 4(4) = 40 − 16 = 24.

questionText: The long-run total cost curve shows the cost of

options.C: all factor inputs that are employed

explanation: In the long run every factor is variable, so there are no fixed costs and the curve records the cost of all inputs used at each level of output.

questionText: The supply of farm produce is mainly determined by
explanation: Crops depend on rainfall, sunshine and the seasons, so a good year yields plenty and a drought or flood cuts supply sharply. The remaining options all act on demand.
